original_test_intent: Verify AGT exposes usable GPU power, current-temperature and junction-temperature telemetry for the eight selected devices during idle and an approved stress condition.
original_method: Collect 1-second PM all-group CSV telemetry with the literal AGT index list, inspect required fields and compare equivalent idle and stress windows.
manual_activity: Operator supervises the approved stress window and cooling/power interlocks; engineer reviews telemetry completeness and limit excursions and decides the DUT verdict.
required_inputs: CSV field schema, units and protected output path
Defined idle state plus approved stress workload and duration
Per-device power/current/junction-temperature limits and abort/recovery policy
safety_requirements: Drain conflicting workloads and verify cooling/power baseline
Capture an uncontaminated idle window first
Continuously monitor approved power and thermal abort thresholds during stress
Stop on missing/malformed sensor data, cooling fault, GPU/XGMI/PCIe/driver or platform error
Stop workload and prove return to idle; do not alter caps/reset GPUs/clear logs
agent_execution_scope: Run the literal AGT PM command with approved binary and output path
Validate timestamps, one-second cadence, numeric fields, units and every selected index
Collect equivalent approved idle and stress windows and compare trends
Do not choose the workload/limits, continue past interlocks or issue DUT PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve tool/index mapping, CSV schema, workload, limits and maintenance window
Resolve telemetry, threshold or platform-log anomalies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The prose-only shortcut omits the source AGT command, exact eight indices and PM CSV fields and cannot safely launch or evaluate stress.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run `sudo ./agt -i=0,5,10,15,20,25,30,35 -unilog=PM -unilogallgroups -unilogperiod=1000 -unilogoutput=pm_xxx.csv` for approved idle and stress windows, preserving the complete CSV and safety logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All eight indices, PM/all-groups, 1000-ms period, CSV telemetry fields, idle/stress intent and source 5/5 timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce per-index aligned idle/stress summaries for power, current temperature and junction temperature with units, sample counts, min/max/trend and safety-event correlation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the comparison reproducible and guarded while leaving project thresholds to engineering authority.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readability and both operating states remain required; telemetry alone is not used to claim correct power management.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Undefined stress and acceptance limits prevent autonomous execution or health judgment even when AGT is readable.

project_override_considerations: Project authority supplies tool, workload and limits; it may refine numeric acceptance but must retain all eight indices, required PM fields and both idle/stress evidence.
expected_evidence: Exact idle/stress AGT commands, exits, timestamps and complete CSVs
Per-index power/current/junction-temperature fields, units and sampling continuity
GPU/XGMI/PCIe/driver/thermal/power plus dmesg/syslog/SEL and recovery-to-idle evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, literal AGT procedure and Criteria consistently target readable PM telemetry at idle and stress; missing workload and limits are prerequisites rather than competing source instructions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: AGT, workload and thresholds are supplyable project inputs; static review is complete and execution remains gated instead of being counted as a hardware failure.

review_improvement: Turns an unspecified comparison into complete eight-index 1-second AGT CSV evidence with safe workload ownership, limit evaluation and return-to-idle proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: A readable CSV proves only that the telemetry path responds. Correct power management requires matched idle and controlled-load windows, stable device mapping, known units and enough samples to distinguish transitions from noise. Junction temperature and platform errors must gate continuation because a workload can be valid yet unsafe.
